name: standing lever one arm shoulder press
description: A standing single-arm shoulder press using a guided lever, with the handle traveling up and forward from the shoulder.
instructions: Stand at the lever machine with your feet planted and take one handle near shoulder height.
Brace your trunk and press the handle upward and slightly forward until the working arm is nearly straight.
Lower the handle slowly to shoulder height without leaning back.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.
